correctness.rationale: For every simple labeled C_n, n>=3, maximal independent sets have cyclic selected-vertex gaps 2 or 3. The earliest-accepted-outside-vertex contradiction proves the priority certificate in both directions. Conditional independent outside priorities give kernel A(u,v)=1-min(u,v) for 2-gaps and rank-one b(u)b(v), b=1-u, for 3-gaps. Cyclic trace factorization proves the complete labeled-set law: all-2 gap probability tr(A^k), otherwise product of phi_a=<b,A^a b>. A=J-M with M the Brownian min-kernel gives trace-class Fredholm D(z)=cosh(sqrt z)-sqrt z sinh(sqrt z) and sum tr(A^k)z^k=-zD'/D. Rational polynomial recurrence verifies phi0=1/3,phi1=1/5,phi2=1/7,phi3=8/81,phi4=34/495. Single dihedral orbit gives uniformity n=3,4,5,7; explicit unequal small profiles handle n=6,8,9,10,11,12,14, and phi0 phi2-phi1^2=4/525>0 gives distinct configurations for every remaining odd n>=13 and even n>=16. Fresh independent first-selected-vertex recursion exactly matched the kernel probabilities for all 83 maximal sets across n=3..11; rational trace identities were checked, not used as an infinite-order proof.
